Predoctoral Fellowships
Ayudas para contratos predoctorales para la formaciÃ³n de doctors (MICIN):
These fellowships are addressed to graduate students that would like to obtain their PhD degree in any field of knowledge. These fellowships are linked to specific research projects, which are supported financially by the âPlan Nacional de I+D+iâ and the Severo Ochoa Excellence Program, amongst others. For more information on the program, application processes, deadlines and other details, please refer to: MICIN
Application deadline usually in October.
Ayudas para la formaciÃ³n de profesorado universitario (FPU):
The FPU fellowships are addressed to graduate students that are interested in obtaining a PhD degree. These fellowships promote the teaching and research education within the personal researcherâs framework. This fellowship is an individual fellowship in contrast to the FPI fellowship, which is associated to research projects. For more information on the program, application processes, deadlines and other details, please refer to: FPU
Applicants need a valid NIE document for the submission.
Application deadline usually in November-December.
FI (AGAUR - Generalitat de Catalunya):
The FI fellowships are oriented essentially towards incorporating PhD students in official PhD and Masters programs with the objective of including them in individual research projects or in research groups that are developing R+D projects.
Application deadline usually in October.
For more information on the program, application processes, requisites, deadlines and other details click here
.
FI-SDUR (Universitat AutÃ²noma de Barcelona) (AGAUR - Generalitat de Catalunya):
The purpose of the support fellowships for university departments and research units FI_SDUR is to boost the research capacity of the departments of the Catalan university system through hiring pre-doctoral researchers. The FI_SDUR programme aims to promote and consolidate joint scientific strategies and policies between university departments and their affiliation entity, with the objective of developing research activities of international impact and strengthening the generation of cross-border knowledge and its transfer.
Application deadline usually in March.
For more information on the program, application processes, requisites, deadlines and other details click here
.
Doctoral INPhINIT fellowships (incoming):
35 fellowships for early-stage researchers of any nationality to pursue their PhD studies in the best Spanish and Portuguese research centres and units with excellence distinction. This frame is addressed exclusively to PhD research projects on STEM disciplines: life sciences and health, experimental sciences, physics, chemistry and mathematics.
Application deadline usually in January.
More information here
.
Doctoral INPhINIT fellowships (retaining): 30 fellowships for early-stage researchers of any nationality to pursue their PhD studies in any research domain in Spain or Portugal.
Application deadline usually January/ February.
More information here
.
Ayudas a Doctorados Industriales (AGAUR - Generalitat de Catalunya):
Fellowships to companies and research centers for the development of an industrial doctorate project.
Application timings open during the entire year in 4 slots.
More information here
.
